opening.argument: The video presents ordinary Wells Fargo job-interview preparation. Its title identifies interview questions as the subject, and the description offers answers and tips. The visible questions ask what to expect in the interview and whether the viewer has worked at a bank before. The video also promotes an external guide and makes a strong employment-outcome claim, but those elements do not establish deception. Nothing in the supplied material shows a request for money, credentials, or financial participation. Nor does it establish a payment requirement, data collection, Wells Fargo affiliation, or what happens after a viewer follows the link. The observable content supports an employment-advice purpose, not a fraudulent transaction.

citations.quote: Brilliant Answers to all tough Wells Fargo interview questions. Wells Fargo interview tips.
